up: For bioactivity records where the standard_type is 'IC50' and standard_units is 'nM', retrieve the standard_value, compound chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, assay description, target preferred name, target organism, and the document's pubmed_id or doi. Join activities with assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, compound_records, and docs. If both pubmed_id and doi exist, prefer pubmed_id.
sql:
SELECT
  a.standard_value,
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  ass.description,
  td.pref_name,
  td.organism,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND td.pref_name = 'Estrogen receptor'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens';
